title: Chicken salad wrap with yoghurt dressing
summary: Ready in 10 minutes with leftover chicken.
steps: Use cooked chicken, or pan-fry a seasoned breast over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes a side until no pink remains. Slice it thinly.
Mix the yoghurt with a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper for the dressing.
Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato and cucumber.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side, spread the dressing down the middle, add the chicken and salad, fold in the ends and roll up.
